status: registered before any model fitting or held-out outcome computation

source.scope: One nominal-command hardware trace; no electrical current, injected fault labels, or independent health certification

selection_disclosure: Before registration the source scripts, column names, row count, command changes, and first/last observations were inspected for suitability. No model was fitted and no held-out predictive/diagnostic score was computed. The held-out segment is withheld from fitting, not an externally blinded dataset.

split.calibration: all records with Time < 400 seconds, containing the first two OFF intervals
split.held_out: all records with Time >= 400 seconds, including a new 70 percent command and its final OFF
split.primary_diagnostic_target: the final positive-to-zero H1 transition after 400 seconds
split.secondary_record: authors validation.csv is retained only as provenance, not scored or fitted in this registered check

models.first_order: dT/dt=(A+G*q-T)/tau, q=H1/100; exact zero-order-hold state update
models.sensor_lag: dTh/dt=(A+G*q-Th)/tau_h; dTs/dt=(Th-Ts)/tau_s; exact two-state zero-order-hold update
models.initial_state: All model states initialized to the mean T1 of calibration rows before the first nonzero heater command. No held-out initial-state refit.
models.ambient_parameter_bounds: initial-state mean plus or minus 5 degrees Celsius
models.sensor_lag_identifiability_constraint: tau_h >= tau_s; the two thermal poles are not uniquely assignable to physical parts from one measured output
models.linear_parameters: For every time-constant grid point solve least squares for A and G using only calibration rows; discard fits outside physical bounds
models.selection: Lowest calibration free-run SSE within each predeclared model; do not select or tune using held-out error
models.command_timing: Use the logged preceding-row H1 value as constant over each interval. Acquisition and command calls differ by an unreported subsecond offset, retained as a limitation.

predictions.primary: Free-run predictions across calibration and held-out segments without measurement resets after initialization
predictions.residual_envelope: Plus/minus the largest absolute calibration free-run residual, augmented by 0.1 degree C numerical/quantization allowance; same width carried into held-out without tuning
predictions.interpretation: Empirical calibration discrepancy envelope, not a probabilistic confidence interval or a hardware sensor specification

diagnostic_checks.unchanged_v2: Run each of the three frozen v2 profile configurations on the observed final OFF, with current absent and command context present; explicitly report ineligible 300-second pair spans and out-of-domain temperatures/time constants

lab_adapted_first_order.parameter_envelope: For first-order grid fits with calibration SSE <= 1.10 times the minimum, take the marginal minima/maxima of A, G, and tau. Multiply G bounds by the publicly logged pre-OFF power fraction for each OFF comparison.
lab_adapted_first_order.temperature_tolerance: Largest absolute residual among accepted calibration first-order free-run fits plus 0.1 degree C; treats unmodeled behavior as empirical discrepancy, not measurement noise
lab_adapted_first_order.module: The frozen v2 interval-compatibility implementation with lab-specific configuration; no current measurements or policy-specific tuning
outputs: pair fractions compatible with OFF / retained pre-OFF power / both / neither
lab_adapted_first_order.nominal_interpretation: Agreement with commanded OFF in an unlabelled nominal experiment, not measured fault sensitivity

diagnostic_checks.sensor_lag: Used only as a predeclared prediction comparator; no new two-state diagnostic detector or synthetic fault injection

reporting.preserve_failures: Report an inadequate first-order fit, wrong alarm, uninformative envelope, or failed direct transfer without adjusting the held-out split, thresholds, grid or model set
reporting.no_population_interval: One held-out OFF is one case, not a fault-rate sample; repeated pairs are correlated and receive no population confidence intervals
claims_excluded: validation of actual stuck-ON fault recall
